Container.Name: OpenWebRX-Plus
Container.Overview: Browser-based, multi-user software-defined radio receiver with a live spectrum and waterfall, browser audio, scanning, recording, analog modes, digital decoders, and SoftMBE digital voice support.
Container.Description: OpenWebRX+ lets users tune and listen to a supported SDR from a modern browser. This template uses the SoftMBE image for DMR, D-Star, YSF, NXDN, FreeDV, and DRM support in addition to OpenWebRX+ analog and digital modes. The default device mapping exposes the host USB bus so the container can access an attached SDR. Keep the receiver on a trusted LAN or VPN unless it is intentionally secured for public multi-user access.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: openwebrx openwebrxplus sdr software defined radio rtl-sdr rtlsdr airspy sdrplay hackrf radio scanner waterfall
Container.Requires: Unraid 6.12 or newer and a supported SDR. The default mapping exposes /dev/bus/usb. A physical SDR normally cannot be opened by multiple containers at once; stop any ADS-B or feeder container using the dongle, or dedicate a second SDR to OpenWebRX+.
Container.Changes: 2026-08-27: Initial Unraid Community Applications template using the actively maintained OpenWebRX+ SoftMBE image.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: OpenWebRX+ browser interface. Change the host port if 8073 is already in use.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Persistent OpenWebRX+ configuration and user database.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: Persistent bookmarks, recordings, decoder output, and runtime data.

Config.Name: SDR USB bus
Config.Description: USB device tree used to access attached SDR hardware. Remove this mapping for a network-only SDR.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: IANA time zone name, for example America/Los_Angeles.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Initial administrator username. The image creates this account on first start if it does not already exist.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Initial administrator password. Required on first installation and masked in the Unraid form.
